_description: The one sentence a node of a type the tool cannot draw is named with (4f's ruling, jsonui-cli 1.9.0; JsonUIShared::AttributeValidatorCore.unknown_component_type_message, and KotlinJsonUI Dynamic's own constant, held to this table from a byte-identical copy). `known` is the types the tool draws; `written` the node's type as written; `expect` the sentence. Type names are matched as written: a spelling that matches a known type only when case is ignored is offered that type.

cases.name: a spelling in another case is offered the declared one
cases.expect: Unknown component type 'switch' — did you mean 'Switch'? Type names are case-sensitive.

cases.name: every letter's case counts
cases.expect: Unknown component type 'SELECTBOX' — did you mean 'SelectBox'? Type names are case-sensitive.

cases.name: a type no path draws is named alone
a registered type is offered like a declared one
cases.expect: Unknown component type 'headerMenu' — did you mean 'HeaderMenu'? Type names are case-sensitive.
